Container.Name: DrawCAD
Container.Overview: Dimension, tolerance and revise technical drawings right on the PDF, in the browser. Linear, ordinate, radius and angle dimensions with AutoCAD-style snapping, ISO 286 fits, GD&T (ISO 1101), surface roughness, revision clouds and tables, OCR for scans, vector PDF and DXF export. The original file is never modified. Runs hardened: read-only filesystem, no extra privileges. No user accounts: keep it on the LAN or set a password.
Container.ExtraParams: --security-opt no-new-privileges:true --cap-drop ALL --cap-add CHOWN --cap-add SETUID --cap-add SETGID --cap-add DAC_OVERRIDE --cap-add FOWNER --read-only --tmpfs /tmp:size=512m --pids-limit 256 --log-opt max-size=10m --log-opt max-file=3

Config.Name: WebUI port
Config.Description: Port of the web interface on the server.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Uploaded documents and their annotations. The owner is set to PUID:PGID automatically.

Config.Name: Password
Config.Description: Optional HTTP Basic password (user: drawcad). Empty = no password, fine on a trusted LAN. Set one if the app is reachable from outside.

Config.Name: Mode
Config.Description: private: each browser has its own documents. personal: a single user, documents visible from any browser. session: like private, only until the browser closes.

Config.Name: Retention days
Config.Description: Unused documents are deleted after this many days (0 = never).

Config.Name: Max upload MB
Config.Description: Maximum size of an uploaded file.

Config.Name: Max pages
Config.Description: Maximum number of pages in an uploaded PDF.

Config.Name: Max image megapixels
Config.Description: Largest uploaded image (scan, photo), in megapixels.

Config.Name: Max render px
Config.Description: Longest side of a rendered page, in pixels.

Config.Name: OCR languages
Config.Description: Tesseract languages for text recognition, joined with +. English and Romanian are included in the image.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User the app runs as (99 = nobody).

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group the app runs as (100 = users).
